idea-plugin.name: Editor Browser
idea-plugin.description:
Websites as editor tabs, right next to your files.

  • One tab per site: Tools › Open URL in Editor Tab… opens localhost:3000, backend.test/admin or any address as a normal editor tab; Tools › New Browser Tab opens a blank one to type into.
  • Splits like a file: right-click the tab › Split Right for code and site side by side.
  • Back, forward, reload, an address bar, zoom (handy in a narrow split) and DevTools in every tab; the page's own favicon becomes the tab icon.
  • Links that open a new window (target="_blank") open as a new tab.
  • Tabs come back after a restart on the page you left them; logins are shared by all tabs.
  • Right-click a selected URL in code › Open in Editor Tab.
  • A run configuration printing a localhost URL (npm run dev, a PHP dev server, …) opens it as a tab automatically; toggle this under Settings › Tools › Editor Browser.

Uses PhpStorm's own embedded Chromium (JCEF). Free and open source on GitHub.
